crossRefs.note: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who…
and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands…
Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies…
For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

translations.web: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.
translations.bsb: For we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives, accomplishing nothing, but being busybodies.
translations.kjv: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
translations.asv: For we hear of some that walk among you disorderly, that work not at all, but are busybodies.
